usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing HA resource's configuration — changing its target state, HA group membership, restart/relocate retry limits, or failback behavior — without removing and re-adding it. Requires `Sys.Console` on `/` (root), so only cluster administrators can call it. The operation returns null synchronously; state changes (e.g. started → stopped) are enacted by the HA manager asynchronously, so poll the resource's actual state via GET after updating.

examples.summary: Move VM 105 into an HA group and cap restart retries, then request it start

params.comment: Critical web VM - high availability group with failback

tips: Use the `digest` parameter when scripting to guard against concurrent edits — fetch the current digest via GET first, then pass it on PUT.
Setting `state` to `ignored` tells the HA manager to leave the resource alone entirely; useful for planned maintenance without removing the resource from HA.
The `delete` param accepts a comma-separated list of config keys (e.g. `comment,group`) to revert individual fields to their defaults without touching the rest.
Changing `group` does not immediately migrate the resource; the HA manager will relocate it when it next evaluates the resource placement.
The shorthand `sid` format (e.g. `100`) resolves to `vm:100` or `ct:100` automatically; use the explicit form when the type matters for clarity.
